name: List All Rental Applications
description: Returns all rental applications that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the rental application

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the property associated with the rental application

queryFilters.name: filters[UnitId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the unit associated with the rental application

queryFilters.name: filters[GroupId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the application group associated with the rental application

queryFilters.name: filters[ScreeningId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the screening associated with the rental application

queryFilters.name: filters[SubmittedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter rental applications submitted at or after this date/time

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of rental application objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the rental application

responseFields.name: data[].RequestedBackgroundReport
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the applicant has requested a copy of their background check report

responseFields.name: data[].HasHousingVoucher
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the applicant has a housing voucher, a government subsidy that assists with rent payments

responseFields.name: data[].AgreedToTerms
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the applicant agreed to the terms and conditions set for the rental application

responseFields.name: data[].ScreeningSubmissions
responseFields.description: Array containing information about each screening submission associated with this rental application

responseFields.name: data[].CampaignId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the campaign associated with the rental application

responseFields.name: data[].GroupId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the application group associated with the rental application

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the rental application

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the rental application

responseFields.name: data[].Bedrooms
responseFields.description: The number of desired bedrooms

responseFields.name: data[].Bathrooms
responseFields.description: The number of desired bathrooms

responseFields.name: data[].Deposit
responseFields.description: The security deposit amount

responseFields.name: data[].ListedMarketRent
responseFields.description: The rent per month as listed on the market

responseFields.name: data[].ListedRent
responseFields.description: The rent per month as listed on the market. This value reflects either the market rent or the advertised rent, depending on whether "Use Market Rent On Ads" is enabled in the AppFolio Property Manager.

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: The rental application's status

responseFields.name: data[].StatusChangedAt
responseFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the application's current status was last modified

responseFields.name: data[].SubmittedAt
responseFields.description: The time the rental application was submitted

responseFields.name: data[].DesiredMoveInDate
responseFields.description: The date the applicant would like to move in

responseFields.name: data[].Dependents
responseFields.description: Contains details about any dependents of the applicant

responseFields.name: data[].Applicant
responseFields.description: Contains details about the rental applicant including their name, contact information, and residential and employment history

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
